objective: Maximize cross-scope terminal wealth by granting slow-trend continuation only to campaigns that have already earned positive actual funded PnL.

failed_predecessor.lesson: Causal score > 0 is too permissive as an ownership continuation state; it raises exposure but preserves stale campaigns.

economic_hypothesis: A funded campaign that is still above its actual weighted acquisition basis has demonstrated realized ownership quality. A generic slow-trend exit may be a temporary trend wobble for such a winner, whereas a campaign at or below basis has not earned continuation. Active opportunity displacement remains available to release capital when a better opportunity appears.

treatment.actual_basis: Observed next-session fills only. The first observed funded inventory uses that session's execution-open price as basis. Later observed additions update the weighted basis using actual prior units plus the new unit delta. Reductions do not improve basis. Full flat inventory clears basis.
treatment.slow_trend_authority: For an actually held symbol, suppress generic slow trend.exit only when current completed-session close is strictly greater than its finite actual weighted acquisition basis.
treatment.unprofitable_campaign: At or below acquisition basis, the campaign follows the parent champion's unchanged slow-trend exit semantics; no extra exit is introduced.
always_authoritative: actual inventory reconciliation and next-session execution
unchanged: market trend requirement for new entries

structural_difference.positive_alpha_compounder: Uses actual funded PnL rather than score sign; it does not create a new score-based self-failure exit.
structural_difference.profit_trend_shield: The old shield only acted during market-shock/recovery states and required EMA20/EMA60 plus 20/60-day positive returns. This candidate is a global security-campaign lifecycle rule based only on actual funded basis, while retaining the later active displacement stack.
structural_difference.committed_offensive_core: Committed core kept the slow trend exit and disabled active displacement. This candidate selectively forgives only profitable campaigns and keeps active displacement.

measurement.primary: mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three scopes
measurement.promotion: Mean-log must strictly exceed the current campaign-peak champion and minimum terminal wealth must not decrease.
measurement.if_promoted: Evaluate the exact same source through all 896 frozen sessions before any further composition.

prohibitions: no profit-margin threshold search above basis
